'double_points' fires on the rule below and doubles the game's daily earn. 'events' are one-offs with from/to dates (inclusive, local date) and an optional 'surfaces' list: app, game (default both). Edit, push, done - nothing to redeploy. An event with a 'hero' block {image, alt, when, venue, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tickets, ribbon} becomes the Social tab's ticket card + the Industry ribbon from now until its date passes (independent of from/to).

_deals_how: Running deals for the configure page (/configure/): percent off the engine price on ONE product, optionally one material/finish, from a quantity up - so a deal can never undercut cost by accident. Fields: id, product (menu name, e.g. 3" Slap), material (optional: White Vinyl | Holographic | Gold), finish (optional: Flat | Spot Gloss UV | Standard Embossing | Pro), fromQty, off (0.15 = 15%), title, until (YYYY-MM-DD or blank). Edit, push, done. 2026-09-17: optional 'from' (YYYY-MM-DD) delays a deal; a deal price is the better of the volume band or the deal, never both. 2026-09-18: 'match':'Flat' = this texture at the Flat price at the same quantity (bands included) - use it for 'X for the Flat price' promos; 'off' stays for % deals. Never both on one deal.
